settings.notice: This is a light-hearted but sincere form. Your answers are sent only to Jordan, are stored in a private Google Sheet in Jordan's own Google account, and are not shared with anyone else or used for anything other than this application. Answer only what you are comfortable sharing; you can skip optional fields. To see, correct or delete your answers at any time, contact jordan.baillod@gmail.com.
settings.consentText: I understand where my answers go, and I agree to submit them.
settings.importantNotice: Submitting this application does NOT guarantee employment. Successful candidates will undergo further screening, including consistency checks, communication assessments, loyalty testing and an extremely serious "Do you actually know how to treat a man?" evaluation.
settings.probation: Good morning texts alone do not constitute satisfactory performance. By submitting, you confirm that all information provided is truthful.
settings.thanksText: Thank you. Your application is now under review. Candidates who are shortlisted will be contacted for the next stage.
settings.legalNote:
A light-hearted private project: this is a personal, non-commercial joke project run by Jordan, a private individual. It is not a real job, a company or a recruitment service. Nothing is sold and no fee is charged.
Adults only: you must be 18 or older to fill in this form. If you are under 18, do not continue.
Voluntary: you are free not to fill it in, and you can close this page at any time. Nothing is stored unless you press Submit. You can skip any optional question.
What is collected: only what you type into the form, and the date and time you submit it. No tracking, advertising tools or analytics are used. Please do not write about other people, and do not enter ID numbers, bank details or passwords.
Who sees it: only Jordan. Your answers are not sold, published, shown to other applicants, or used for anything except this application.
Where it is stored: in a private Google Sheet in Jordan's own Google account. Google's servers may be located outside Japan (for example in the United States). By submitting, you agree to your answers being stored there.
How long: Your answers are kept only for this application. They are deleted permanently no later than 60 days after you submit them, and sooner if you ask. If you are not selected, or you withdraw, they are deleted on request.
Your rights: you can ask at any time to see, correct or delete your answers, before or after submitting, by writing to jordan.baillod@gmail.com with your reference number. Requests are handled promptly.
If this bothers you: it is meant as a joke between adults. If you are not comfortable with it, simply close the page, or write to jordan.baillod@gmail.com and you will not be contacted about it again.
Care with your data: your information is handled carefully and in the spirit of Japan's Act on the Protection of Personal Information (APPI). This notice is a plain-language description, not legal advice.
